title: Does gold catch up with the other havens (yen, franc, US 10-year Treasury)?

rule.haven: equal-weight mean of weekly log returns of 1/USDJPY, 1/USDCHF, USB10Y
rule.residual: e = g - alpha - beta x h, OLS on the 52 weeks before
rule.entry: next gold daily open; T1/T3 held 5 candles, stop 2 x ATR(20); T2 held 10 candles, stop 3 x ATR(20)
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long on longs

tests.what: gold's weekly residual against the haven index beyond 1 sd, faded (gold closes the gap), 5 candles (primary)
the same residual signal held 10 candles, stop 3 x ATR(20)
raw haven week beyond 1 sd: gold the same way as the havens, 5 candles
